from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Optional
import dacite
@dataclass
class Trip:
    """
    A trip from a start location to a destination consisting of ordered legs
    """
    pageTitle:str
    name:Optional[str] # short name of the trip used as page name e.g. BariLjubljana2026
    title:Optional[str] # human readable title of the trip
    from:Optional[str] # id of the start location of the trip
    to:Optional[str] # id of the destination of the trip
    start:Optional[str] # first day of the trip
    end:Optional[str] # last day of the trip
    participants:Optional[str] # who travels
    status:Optional[str] # planning state of the trip
    source:Optional[str] # url of the source the trip is derived from e.g. a YouTube playlist or a travel blog
    description:Optional[str] # description of the trip

    @classmethod
    def askQuery(cls):
        """
        get the ask Query for Trip

        Returns:
            str: the mediawiki markup for the ask query
        """
        ask="""{{#ask: [[Concept:Trip]]
|mainlabel=pageTitle
|?Trip name = name
|?Trip title = title
|?Trip from = from
|?Trip to = to
|?Trip start = start
|?Trip end = end
|?Trip participants = participants
|?Trip status = status
|?Trip source = source
|?Trip description = description
|limit=10000
|format=table
}}"""
        return ask

    @classmethod
    def fromDict(cls,data:dict):
        """
        create a Trip from the given dict

        Args:
            data(dict): the dict to create the Trip from

        Returns:
            Trip: the freshly created Trip
        """
        trip=dacite.from_dict(data_class=cls,data=data)
        return trip
